    - id: agreement-date-present
      severity: error
      description: agreement_date is required for Purchase Agreement extraction.
      rule:

        rules:
          - op: present
            field: agreement_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: agreement_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: agreement_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(agreement_date)) > 0

    - id: purchase-price-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: purchase_price should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: purchase_price

            left:
              field: purchase_price
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: purchase_price IS NULL OR purchase_price >= 0
      supported: true
